digest.component_or_area: Git version floor CI gate in _build-and-test.yml
propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and hard-fails with exit 1 when the file is absent, even though the workflow definition comes from main

Changes branched before the floor-file was merged inherit the new gate step from main but lack the data file in their tree, causing false Verified -1 failures unrelated to actual git version violations

The gate step violates the established definition-vs-tree skew guard pattern documented for this repository; adjacent steps (raw-git-write gate, wall-clock-assert gate) already implement the if-present skip pattern

The fix applies the documented if-present guard: skip with an explanatory log line when the floor file is absent from the checked-out tree, while preserving unchanged 980d's under-floor enforcement (required version, installed version, upgrade path)
Test coverage confirms the fix works both for trees lacking the floor file and trees having it, using the actual step script extracted from the workflow YAML
